text: {"outcome": "deny", "rationale": "We must deny the claim because the claimant admitted to driving while over the legal blood alcohol limit. This triggers the policy exclusion for impaired driving, making the loss not covered. The governing clause is BASIC-4.6.", "citations": [{"clause_id": "BASIC-4.6", "quote": "We do not cover loss that occurs while the driver of the covered vehicle is under the influence of alcohol, a controlled substance or any drug that impairs driving ability, including any case in which the driver's measured blood alcohol concentration exceeds the legal limit of the state where the loss occurred."}]}
